jobs.role: DGM-HR (Lead HR) DeHaat (Green Agrevolution Pvt Ltd
bullets: Strategic Policy Development: Led the review and revamp of core employee policies (Performance Incentive, Transfer, Notice Period & Leave Policy etc.) to improve competitiveness and align with business expansion.

HR Technology & Data Foundation: Guided the implementation of a new HRMS System, which included migrating and cleaning cluttered legacy data to establish reliable, structured HR information and reporting.

Performance & Talent Infrastructure: Introduced a data-driven performance culture by implementing Role- wise KRAs and Quarterly Performance Check-ins, utilizing the resulting data to drive targeted Learning & Development (L&D) planning.

Organizational Development & Clarity: Managed Role Dimensioning and collaborated on creating defined Role-wise Career Paths to enhance organizational structure and support talent retention strategies.

Strategic Project Management and Employee Benefits: Managed and executed complex, company-wide HR initiatives and deep-dive projects, including the "Great Place to Work" certification process, Employee Pulse Surveys, and Focus Group Discussions (FGDs), to actively shape culture and retention strategies. Organize companywide employee engagement events across all company locations in India.
Scale and Setup: Led HR setup and scaling for the Delhi NCR region from 0 to 45+ hubs, working directly with Business, Sales, and Operations Heads to define manpower needs.
High-Volume Hiring: Directed the rapid hiring and onboarding of 1000+ personnel within 06 months, establishing foundational HR systems.

Cost Savings: Executed a strategic Opex reduction initiative by tracking per order delivery cost and restructuring the last-mile delivery model (e.g., part-time partners, third-party E-Rickshaw integration).
Operational Achievement: Achieved a substantial reduction in per order delivery cost from approximately Rs. 7.5 to Rs. 3.5-4 through strategic model changes and performance alignment.
Incentive Program: Revamped compensation by shifting from fixed monthly pay to performance-based incentives for delivery partners, significantly boosting morale and driving higher productivity.
Building structural Foundation: Framed HR policies and operational workflows aligned with leadership vision, facilitating a smooth regional launch.
Conducted Competency Mapping and resolved employee queries, arranging necessary HR interventions.
Guided performance processes and rewards management for the zonal team.
Talent Development: Implemented competency mapping exercises and tailored Learning and Development (L&D) interventions for field and central staff.
Led hiring efforts and managed the manpower budget for a new regional setup.
Established and implemented comprehensive HR systems, including policy framing, for smooth operations in the North Zone.
Managed the acquisition of HR-related licenses and ensured statutory compliance across the region.
Delivered Performance Management System (PMS) workshops, covering goal setting and appraisals, and conducted periodic HR process audits.
Managed vendors and ensured accurate and timely payroll inputs.
Recruitment: Handled high-volume, bulk recruitment strategies to staff all new store openings in Rajasthan and manage consistent attrition/replacement needs across the cluster.
Engagement: Directed comprehensive Employee Engagement and Wellness programs, including managing employee benefits and serving as the primary advisor on people issues.
HR Management: Managed the complete employee lifecycle, ensuring strict adherence to HR policies and procedures, and ensured the timely closure of the Performance Management System (PMS).

Compliance/Audit: Conducted regular HR compliance and process audits for all Rajasthan stores, ensuring smooth operations during new store openings and the rationalization/closure of non-performing stores.
Supported the implementation of corporate HR strategies, managing end-to-end HR operations, manpower planning, recruitment, and employee relations.
Maintained strict statutory compliance with labor laws, assisted in government relations, and managed comprehensive payroll administration and employee benefits processing.
Administered critical employee welfare initiatives, including the provisioning of free hostel accommodations, subsidized meals, and vehicle access.
Managed township infrastructure, external vendor relations, and the procurement of administrative supplies and services for the plant site. akhilesh_agrawal44@yahoo.com akhilesh_agrawal44@yahoo.com
